title: More Fire!
altText: Vibrant red surreal street art mural painted by Mr Blob on the side of a residential house in the UK, featuring a detailed cartoon character with pop art elements on Garnet St.
description: Created for Upfest on the gable of a residential house on Garnet Street in Bristol, this piece bursts off a saturated red background with a wide-eyed furry creature clutching a vinyl record, its many limbs wielding spray cans and a paint roller amid swirling trails of fire and scattered papers. The dense cartoon detailing and pop-art props are rendered entirely in freehand spray paint.
